old: Every address is screened against blocklists before assignment and re-checked daily, but the trial address comes out of the same /24 as paying customers, so blocklist reputation is shared across the block. Traffic detours to Karaganda: the vendor measures 78 ms round trip to Frankfurt and 161 ms to Virginia. Outbound 25, 465 and 587 are blocked on every lease until asked. A lapsed renewal stops traffic and holds the address for 7 days before it returns to the pool.
new: unverified: behind a sign-up. The source address one request through a lease returns cannot be measured without provisioning a lease: the keyless endpoints GET /api/plans/ and GET /api/ answered and returned only the plan catalogue and two links, with no per-request echo of the caller's address. Obtaining an address needs an order body with an organization name, country and billing email, and a WireGuard config that must be brought up on a machine holding the tunnel; no order or tunnel was created, so no exit address was observed and the rung is unchanged. Every address is screened against blocklists before assignment and re-checked daily afterwards.
